title: Normalize a rate-dependent collision recursion through a conserved currency
statement: The completed working construction uses conserved currency h(v)=a+|v|^2 and g_t=h f_t/(a+e0). A recursive rate-dependent collision lineage samples the actual partner, accepts the physical collision rate under an explicit local clock and selects an outgoing particle proportional to h. Final acceptance a/h returns weight-one f_t output with mean proposal count (a+e0)/a. The proof supplies almost-sure termination and a finite expected full-tree cost with an exponential-in-time bound.

requires: Declared initial velocity law/support and finite moments, actual hard-sphere rate and collision generator
Constructed partner recursion and paid local clock; no partner-law oracle
Fresh independent ideal randomness and model-qualified output contract

Weight-one iid bounded tests permit ordinary Hoeffding bounds after all output preparation costs
